Attached: 1 image

The mistake I see most: backing up to a folder on the same server.

It works until that disk fills, and then backups take the app down with them.

Better: keep a short local window, send the real history to S3 or an external mount. One container can dump several databases, each with its own schedule, then ship the files off the box.

Full config in the guide:
https://danielpetrica.com/posts/easy-database-backups-with-docker-compose

#Docker #DevOps #SelfHosted
